description: Very weathered ex-VNAF F-5 in the museum grounds, photographed in January 2025 still wearing Imperial Iranian Air Force markings from a pre-1975 transfer batch - an unusual survival worth checking against IIAF records.
Ex-VNAF A-37 with faded paint and flat tyres when photographed in January 2025.
Huey in the museum grounds carrying the marking GB-323, photographed January 2025. The GB prefix is not a standard US or VNAF serial form and may be a local inventory number.
